names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him, which day-candidates.mjs prints as `name: Иоанн (Земляной), иерей, сщмч.`; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE and a Cyrillic grep for «Земляной» over every `saint.json` returns nothing.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth, and no reading behind the line.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Петра и Иоанна пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: The second of the two presbyters of the day’s fourth and last line, and the line and the name pages are all there is: no life page stands behind it for either man. The `related` row between the two follows the ruling this corpus took for a short joint line with no reading behind it. No folder held him. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, AND THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED.
